source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
An engaged unit can Fall Back up to its M, following the [Moving](vsdata:core-rule/moving) rules. First pick a mode: a Battle-shocked unit cannot pick **Ordered Retreat** and must use **Desperate Escape**, which means:

- Before moving, each model makes a [Hazard roll](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls).
- While moving, models can pass through enemy models.
- After moving, the unit makes a Battle-shock roll unless it is already Battle-shocked.

In either mode the unit must end unengaged and, unless a rule says otherwise, cannot shoot, charge or begin an action until the turn ends.

desperateEscape.whileMoving: models can move through enemy models
